name: Ray Crossing Count (Winding Number)
definition: A method to determine if a point is inside a closed mesh by counting ray-triangle intersections. A point not inside the object should have value 0, no point should ever have values < 0, and points inside the object should have a value of exactly 1.
summary: Ray Crossing Count determines point-in-mesh containment by summing signed ray-triangle intersections, yielding a generalized winding number that handles non-manifold configurations unlike simple binary hit tests.
